note:
v0.29.1 复盘卡视觉修正

· 复盘卡排版：修掉「正文压过品牌分隔线、拼音被二维码盖住」—— 收紧块间距并加入「正文优先」的自动收高，正文再也不会顶穿品牌线。
· 复盘卡文案：弱点行改为纯英文，不再出现「Most often tricky: 4 声字」这种中英夹生。
· 路径卡：旅程结束后的复盘节点下，也能看到「这句连错 3 次 ⇒ 换个做法」的出口。
noteEn:
v0.29.1 Trip-card visual fixes

· Trip card layout: fixed text pushing past the brand rule and the pinyin sliding under the QR card — tighter spacing plus "content-first" auto-fit, so text can never cross the brand line again.
· Trip card copy: the tricky-sounds line is now English-only (no more mixed-language line).
· Path card: the "missed this 3x — change the approach" shortcut now also shows on the retro node after a trip ends.
